entries.name: Alert
entries.description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls. Right after rolling Initiative, you can swap your result with a willing ally's (not if either of you is Incapacitated).

entries.name: Magic Initiate
entries.description: You learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list (spellcasting ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, your choice). The spell is always prepared and you cast it once for free per Long Rest, or with a spell slot. You can swap one when you gain a level. Repeatable, with a different list.

entries.name: Savage Attacker
entries.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either result.

entries.name: Skilled
entries.description: You gain proficiency in any three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20. Repeatable.

entries.name: Grappler
entries.description: Strength or Dexterity +1 (max 20). When you hit with an Unarmed Strike during the Attack action, you can deal damage and grapple at once (once per turn). You have Advantage on attacks against a creature you're grappling, and moving it costs no extra movement if it's your size or smaller.

entries.name: Archery
entries.description: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Defense
entries.description: +1 to Armor Class while wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor.

entries.name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries.description: When you roll damage for a melee attack with a weapon held in two hands (Two-Handed or Versatile), a 1 or 2 on a damage die counts as a 3.

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries.description: When you make the extra attack with a Light weapon, add your ability modifier to its damage (if not already added).

entries.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
entries.description: +1 to one ability score (max 30). Peerless Aim: when you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead; you can't use this again until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
entries.description: +1 to one ability score (max 30). After taking the Attack or Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Boon of Fate
entries.description: +1 to one ability score (max 30). When you or another creature within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the result as a bonus or penalty. It recharges when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
entries.description: Strength or Dexterity +1 (max 30). Your Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage ignores Resistance. On a 20 on the attack roll, you deal extra damage equal to the increased score, of the attack's type.

entries.name: Boon of Spell Recall
entries.description: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma +1 (max 30). When you cast a spell with a level 1-4 slot, roll 1d4: if the result equals the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

entries.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
entries.description: +1 to one ability score (max 30). In Dim Light or Darkness you can become Invisible as a Bonus Action (it ends when you act), and you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

entries.name: Boon of Truesight
entries.description: +1 to one ability score (max 30). You have Truesight out to 60 feet.
